tests.name: shared assistant tool dispatcher is mounted and requires auth (rejected write probe)

tests.reason: every tool in this change writes on a member's behalf — a calendar entry, a feed post that fans out to the whole tenant, or a chat message to a real person; staging shares the production Supabase project, so none of it is exercised there. These suites prove it with the real handlers over a fake database: nothing is created, posted or sent until the member confirmed, nothing for a time that has passed, share and invite reuse the Phase 2/3 services, the live session additionally requires that the member has spoken, text chat and the LiveKit agent reach the same handlers, and the role registry lists the real calendar tools.
